storyteller_rules: Load education/socialization before personality in every scene.
Do not let capability scores become visible narration or RPG stats.
A high score never guarantees success under shame, status threat, fatigue or low formal power.
A low score may improve over 2026-2035 only if later ledger behavior supports it.
Do not invent formal credentials, internships or leadership roles as historical facts; adaptation-only resumes remain replaceable.
Original family influence is attenuated by long educational and professional socialization, but may reappear around money, care, hometown, authority and shame.
